ValidationRule.description: Ensures that Leads in 'New' status can only be moved to 'In Progress' or 'Closed Lost'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "New"), ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Lost")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: From 'New', you can only move the Lead to 'In Progress' or 'Closed Lost'.
